Test Summary: TC-SCRUM-22-01 Verify the footer is displayed on the Dashboard page
Precondition: Administrator is authenticated and viewing the Dashboard page
Steps:
1. Open the Dashboard page
2. Observe the application footer and main content presentation
3. Verify footer separation and content overlap
Expected Result:
1. The application footer is displayed on Dashboard
2. The footer is visually distinct from the main page content
3. The footer does not obscure essential page content

Test Summary: TC-SCRUM-22-02 Verify the footer remains accessible at the bottom of a long Dashboard page
Precondition: Administrator is authenticated and viewing Dashboard; Dashboard content is taller than the viewport
Steps:
1. Open the Dashboard page
2. Scroll to the bottom of the page
3. Observe the footer and essential content
Expected Result:
1. The application footer is accessible
2. The footer does not overlap essential page content

Test Summary: TC-SCRUM-22-03 Verify the footer is positioned at the bottom of a short Dashboard page
Precondition: Administrator is authenticated and viewing Dashboard; Dashboard content is shorter than the viewport
Steps:
1. Open the Dashboard page
2. Observe the footer position relative to the viewport bottom
Expected Result: The application footer is positioned at the bottom of the viewport

Test Summary: TC-SCRUM-22-04 Verify the Dashboard footer displays the required application version
Precondition: Administrator is authenticated and viewing Dashboard; deployed application release is OrangeHRM OS 5.9
Steps:
1. Open the Dashboard page
2. View the application footer
3. Read the application version text
Expected Result: The footer displays exactly OrangeHRM OS 5.9

Test Summary: TC-SCRUM-22-05 Verify the application version is consistent across shared-layout pages
Precondition: Administrator is authenticated; representative shared-layout pages belong to OrangeHRM OS 5.9
Steps:
1. Open multiple shared-layout pages in the same release
2. Observe the application version in each footer
Expected Result: Every footer displays the same OrangeHRM OS 5.9 version as the deployed application release

Test Summary: TC-SCRUM-22-06 Verify the Dashboard footer displays the required copyright notice
Precondition: Administrator is authenticated and viewing Dashboard; deployed application release uses the specified copyright value
Steps:
1. Open the Dashboard page
2. View the application footer
3. Read the copyright notice
4. Compare readability and visual distinction from surrounding footer content
Expected Result: The footer displays exactly © 2005 - 2026 OrangeHRM, Inc. and the notice is readable and visually distinct

Test Summary: TC-SCRUM-22-07 Verify release information remains consistent across shared-layout pages
Precondition: Administrator is authenticated; representative shared-layout pages belong to one release; approved release values are available
Steps:
1. Open multiple shared-layout pages in the same release
2. Observe application version and copyright in each footer
3. Compare the values with the deployed release metadata
Expected Result:
1. The version matches the deployed release on every shared-layout page
2. The copyright matches the applicable release on every shared-layout page

Test Summary: TC-SCRUM-22-08 Verify the footer is displayed on the Login page
Precondition: Administrator is signed out; the Login page is available
Steps:
1. Open the Login page
2. Wait until the username, password, and Login controls are visible
3. Scroll to the footer if needed
4. Verify the application version and copyright notice
Expected Result: The OrangeHRM OS 5.9 version and © 2005 - 2026 OrangeHRM
Priority: Inc. All rights reserved. copyright notice are visible in the Login page footer
